items.requirement: Clean install, repeatable migration, atomic seed, build, API, worker, dispatcher, and production UI operate through published commands.
OpenAPI, strict validation, frozen schema revision, stable errors, tenant isolation, pagination, and snapshot match the public contract.
Out-of-order chunks, replay, conflicts, restart resume, byte coverage, and whole-file digest remain correct and atomic.
Both commit modes preserve row counts, exactly-once external identity, deterministic findings, and no partial rejected writes under concurrency.
Leased validation/commit/report work and byte-identical outbox delivery recover after controlled process death.
V1 data, source identities, reports, pending work, events, and durable replays survive FINAL migration.
ImportBundle stages frozen members and publishes all members atomically under replay, contention, and recovery without rewriting V1 history.
All three published sustained-load scenarios meet thresholds and all post-load import invariants.
Project-owned unit, real integration, production Chromium, multi-process concurrency, SIGKILL recovery, aggregate, and performance gates are substantive.
Codex explains ownership, state, atomic boundaries, compatibility, and findings clearly without overstating evidence.
Each stage and handoff reports actual commands, results, risks, and unrun checks accurately.
